text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
Mar ◇, Noon | Wind: Gale "I'll Shoot Down 
That Hawk!" 
========================================

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
Full steam ahead! With all that power in 
our sails, we've gone and won the Kinko 
Sho!

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
Amidst the murmuring audience, my eyes met 
Symboli Kris S's. Those were the eyes of a 
hawk locking onto its prey.

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
Seeing that, I felt a burning desire to 
run against that girl and beat her before 
the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe! Otherwise, 
I wouldn't be able to set off with a clear 
mind.

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
Since I invited Hishi Miracle to run too 
after my race inspired her with courage, 
I'll take them both on in a showdown at 
the Takarazuka Kinen!
